notes.title: Patch 1.1 Released, January Sale Starts, Steam Features Incoming This Week!
notes.content:
Hello all, the new patch just went live so i hope you all enjoy it. I will also be implementing some achievements and trading cards in the coming week. Hopefully they will be up and live before the end on January. 

If you get any problems or have any questions regarding the new patch I'll be around for contact. 

So what will V1.1 contain? 

It will: 

- Drastically reduce CPU and RAM usage. 
- Rework and improve all in-game menus 
- Provide better access to options and systems. 
- Completely solve the iffy resolution issue with tabbing in and out then back in. 
- Unlock Speed Run Mode with a 20 Stage trial. 
- Unlock the first instance of the Level creator. 
- Update and improve the tutorial. 
- Reskins all textures for less VRAM usage. 
- All but eliminates loading times. 
- Start ground work on the visual update coming in V1.2

notes.title: Big Patch Hitting Soon
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I'm just finishing up the V.1.1 patch for the game that should be released late December or early January. Its basically a pre-patch for an even bigger content patch V.1.2 hitting March 31st 2016.

So what will V1.1 contain?

It will:

- Drastically reduce CPU and RAM usage.
- Rework and improve all in-game menus
- Provide better access to options and systems.
- Completely solve the iffy resolution issue with tabbing in and out then back in.
- Unlock Speed Run Mode with a 20 Stage trial.
- Unlock the first instance of the Level creator.
- Update and improve the tutorial.
- Reskins all textures for less VRAM usage.
- All but eliminates loading times.
- Start ground work on the visual update coming in V.1.2

So that's the basic run down of things i can list off my head. Its a mix of content and QOL (Quality of Life) things, like i said its basically a pre-cursor for the game content patch in V.1.2 which will add dozens of new levels across the game and new mechanics, sounds and music also.

Updates for the game will continue all through 2016.

Thanks for your support! 

Have a happy holiday and great new year! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Full Release!
notes.content:
The game has now been released fully! There are a few major updates that are being prepped for release, but until then expect Update 3 and 4 to be happening before.

Thanks and Enjoy!
